Game Overview

In Mutant Plants Vs Zombie, the core idea is straightforward: unleash mutant plants in strategic battles against relentless zombie hordes. Craft a potent botanical army by merging and upgrading your defenses to unleash devastating attacks. As the undead grow in strength and diversity, adapt your strategy, manage resources wisely, and save humanity from impending doom.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Mutant Plants Vs Zombie is easy to pick up. Unleash mutant plants in strategic battles against relentless zombie hordes.
